verdict.rationale: Postman's docs describe registering an external MCP server with its Fabric Gateway to make its tools available to a team, and Agent Mode can act on natural-language instructions across the API lifecycle — suggesting Postman can consume external MCP tool servers. However, evidence is limited to a single doc page with no hands-on confirmation of the workflow, and other MCP-related evidence (MCP Generator, mcp.postman.com) is about Postman acting as an MCP server rather than a client.
